correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic, the canonical hyperelliptic degree-two class is a rational even theta characteristic; the 28 odd classes are 2-subsets of eight ramification points and the other 35 even classes are complementary 4-subset pairs. The two explicit fixed-point formulas for \(O_n\) and \(E_n\) follow from the branch-point permutation action: invariant two-subsets for odd structures and invariant-or-complemented four-subsets for even structures. Every partition of 8 is enumerated once. The exact standalone checker computes orbit spectra on the actual 28+35 objects and independently computes fixed counts by the generating-function method for all powers up to the permutation order, obtains 22 distinct 3-level tuples and precisely three 2-level collisions. The \((1,7)\) and \((3,5)\) examples exist over every odd finite field by irreducible-polynomial existence. Finite computation is exhaustive only for 22 integer partitions; uniformity in \(q\) uses algebraic geometry.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact arithmetic reconstruction theorem: two canonical theta-characteristic schemes carry small-extension point counts from which the intrinsic branch splitting of any genus-three hyperelliptic curve can be recovered. The optimal depth three and parity-by-parity failures demonstrate a substantive boundary. It is not just a numerical table, does not purport to reconstruct curve moduli, and need not outperform direct polynomial factorization to be mathematically useful. Although some of the 22 abstract branch partitions are not realizable over the smallest fields, the two patterns used for sharpness are realizable over every odd finite field.
